text: きたえて　やってくれ

structure.jp: きたえて　やってくれ

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.explanation: やる after a て-form says you do something for someone, said from above to someone lower or close. きたえて　やって = 'train her (for her sake)'

patterns.name: 〜てくれ
patterns.explanation: くれ after a て-form is a blunt, manly way to ask someone to do something for you. やってくれ = 'do it for me'
